note: Fresh runtime solve of retained build-1 binary; not original build environment or future release solve. URLs are sanitized binary URLs; license metadata and file paths are not legal conclusions.

package_metadata.info/recipe/recipe.yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: renderdem
  version: "1.0"
  upstream_commit: "93502f2e225be0cebcb8663db3bc5058baa3eb1e"
  source_sha256: "748cb2839db7d24ee3fdce034e8637829630a9d68ec6561fb76523e25d24af8d"

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  # ODM 3.6.2 references main; this pins its researched head.
  url: https://codeload.github.com/OpenDroneMap/RenderDEM/tar.gz/93502f2e225be0cebcb8663db3bc5058baa3eb1e
  sha256: ${{ source_sha256 }}

build:
  number: 1
  skip: target_platform != "linux-64"
  python:
    skip_pyc_compilation:
      - share/odm-conda/**/*.py
  script:
    file: ../../scripts/build_component.py
    interpreter: python

requirements:
  build:
    - python >=3.12,<3.13
    - cmake >=3.31,<3.32
    - ninja >=1.11,<2
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
  host:
    - libpdal-core >=2.10.0,<2.10.1
    - libgdal-core >=3.12.2,<3.12.3
    - libgomp >=14
  run:
    - libpdal-core >=2.10.0,<2.10.1
    - libgdal-core >=3.12.2,<3.12.3
    - libgomp >=14

tests:
  - package_contents:
      files:
        - bin/renderdem
        - share/licenses/renderdem/*
        - share/odm-conda/renderdem/SOURCE.txt
        - share/odm-conda/renderdem/functional_test.py
  - script:
      interpreter: python
      content: |
        import runpy
        import sys
        from pathlib import Path
        installed = Path(sys.prefix) / "share" / "odm-conda" / "renderdem" / "functional_test.py"
        runpy.run_path(str(installed), run_name="__main__")
    requirements:
      run:
        - python >=3.12,<3.13

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/OpenDroneMap/RenderDEM
  repository: https://github.com/OpenDroneMap/RenderDEM
  summary: Render digital elevation model tiles from a point cloud
  description: >-
    Unofficial native packaging of a component used by OpenDroneMap.
    This is not the complete ODM engine. Native package and license review
    are required before distribution.
  license: AGPL-3.0-only AND MIT
  license_file:
    - .conda-notices/renderdem-AGPL-3.0.txt
    - .conda-notices/cxxopts-MIT.txt
    - .conda-notices/packaging-MIT.txt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - archont561
package_metadata.info/recipe/variant_config.yaml:
c_compiler: gcc
c_compiler_version: '14'
c_stdlib: sysroot
c_stdlib_version: '2.28'
cxx_compiler: gxx
cxx_compiler_version: '14'
target_platform: linux-64
